import subprocess, re
region='chrX:154398500-154398500'
proc=subprocess.run(['samtools','view','variant.status.q1.bam',region], text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
pos=154398500
ops_re=re.compile(r'(\\d+)([MIDNSHP=X])')
counts={}
for line in proc.stdout.strip().splitlines():
    f=line.split('\\t')
    qname,flag,rname,start,mapq,cigar,seq,qual=f[0],int(f[1]),f[2],int(f[3]),int(f[4]),f[5],f[9],f[10]
    ref=start; qi=0; base=None; bq=None
    for n,op in ops_re.findall(cigar):
        n=int(n)
        if op in 'M=X':
            if ref <= pos < ref+n:
                qi += pos-ref
                base=seq[qi]
                bq=ord(qual[qi])-33
                break
            ref += n; qi += n
        elif op in 'DN':
            if ref <= pos < ref+n:
                base='DEL/SKIP'; break
            ref += n
        elif op in 'IS':
            qi += n
        elif op in 'HP':
            pass
    strand='-' if flag & 16 else '+'
    tags={}
    for x in f[11:]:
        parts=x.split(':',2)
        if len(parts)==3: tags[parts[0]]=parts[2]
    counts[base]=counts.get(base,0)+1
    print(base, 'bq', bq, 'strand', strand, 'start', start, 'cigar', cigar, 'mapq', mapq, 'nM', tags.get('nM'), qname)
print('counts', counts)

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import subprocess, re, collections
bam='variant.status.q1.bam'; chrom='chrX'; pos=154398500
sam=subprocess.check_output(['samtools','view',bam,f'{chrom}:{pos}-{pos}'], text=True)
counts=collections.Counter(); quals=collections.defaultdict(list); strands=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); rows=[]
for line in sam.splitlines():
    fields=line.split('\\t')
    qname,flag,rname,start,mapq,cigar,seq,qual=fields[0],int(fields[1]),fields[2],int(fields[3]),int(fields[4]),fields[5],fields[9],fields[10]
    ref=start; read=0; base=None; bq=None
    for n,op in re.findall(r'(\\d+)([MIDNSHP=X])', cigar):
        n=int(n)
        if op in 'M=X':
            if ref <= pos < ref+n:
                read += pos-ref
                base=seq[read]
                bq=ord(qual[read])-33
                break
            ref += n; read += n
        elif op in 'DN':
            if ref <= pos < ref+n:
                base='-' if op=='D' else 'N_SKIP'; bq=None; break
            ref += n
        elif op in 'IS':
            read += n
        elif op in 'HP':
            pass
    if base:
        counts[base]+=1; quals[base].append(bq if bq is not None else -1); strands[base]['rev' if flag & 16 else 'fwd']+=1
        rows.append((qname, flag, start, cigar, mapq, base, bq, 'rev' if flag&16 else 'fwd'))
print('counts', counts)
for b in sorted(quals):
    qs=quals[b]
    print(b, 'n=',len(qs),'minQ=',min(qs),'meanQ=',sum(qs)/len(qs),'strand=',dict(strands[b]))
print('\\nrows')
for r in rows:
    print('\\t'.join(map(str,r)))
PY"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import re
import subprocess
import sys


BAM, CHROM, POS_TEXT, OBS_OUT, SUMMARY_OUT = sys.argv[1:]
POS = int(POS_TEXT)
MIN_MAPQ = 20
MIN_BASEQ = 20
# A value of 2 excludes bases in the first or last two sequencing cycles.
MIN_END_DISTANCE = 2
EXCLUDED_FLAGS = 0x4 | 0x100 | 0x200 | 0x400 | 0x800
CIGAR_RE = re.compile(r"(\d+)([MIDNSHP=X])")


def observation_at_target(start, cigar, sequence, qualities):
    ref_pos = start
    query_pos = 0
    for length_text, op in CIGAR_RE.findall(cigar):
        length = int(length_text)
        if op in "M=X":
            if ref_pos <= POS < ref_pos + length:
                offset = POS - ref_pos
                q_index = query_pos + offset
                return sequence[q_index].upper(), ord(qualities[q_index]) - 33, q_index
            ref_pos += length
            query_pos += length
        elif op in "DN":
            if ref_pos <= POS < ref_pos + length:
                return None
            ref_pos += len

import pysam
bam='variant.status.q1.bam'
pos=154398500
af=pysam.AlignmentFile(bam,'rb')
counts={}
rows=[]
for r in af.fetch('chrX', pos-1, pos):
    pairs=r.get_aligned_pairs(matches_only=False, with_seq=True)
    for qpos,rpos,base in pairs:
        if rpos==pos-1 and base is not None:
            counts[base.upper()]=counts.get(base.upper(),0)+1
            rows.append((r.query_name, r.flag, r.reference_start+1, r.cigarstring, qpos+1, rpos+1, base, r.mapping_quality, r.query_qualities[qpos] if qpos is not None and qpos < len(r.query_qualities) else None))
            break
print('counts', counts)
print('total rows', len(rows))
for row in rows:

import pysam, collections
bam='variant.status.q1.bam'; chrom='chrX'; p0=154398470; p1=154398520
b=pysam.AlignmentFile(bam,'rb')
rows=[]
for rec in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    if rec.is_unmapped or rec.reference_name"'!=chrom: continue
    if rec.reference_end<=p0 or rec.reference_start>=p1: continue
    # map reference positions to bases in aligned orientation; query_sequence is alignment orientation
    mp={r:(rec.query_sequence[q] if q is not None else '"'-') for q,r in rec.get_aligned_pairs(matches_only=False) if r is not None}
    rows.append((rec,mp))
print('reads intersecting window',len(rows))
print('pos\\t'+'\\t'.join(str(x) for x in range(p0,p1)))
for rec,mp in rows:
    print(rec.query_name, rec.flag, rec.reference_start+1, rec.reference_end, rec.cigarstring, ''.join(mp.get(x,' ') for x in range(p0,p1)))
print('\\ncounts')
for x in range(p0,p1):
 c=collections.Counter(mp.get(x,'-') for rec,mp in rows if x in mp)
 if c: print(x, c)
print('\\ntags first')
for rec,mp in rows[:20]: print(rec.query_name, rec.get_tags())
